item.title: Learning Go
item.description: Book: Learning Go # Go Run -> Use go run when you want to treat a Go program like a script and run the source code immediately. Go Build -> build a binary for later use Getting Third-Party Go Tools # Go’s method for publishing code is a bit different than most other languages. Go developers don’t rely on a centrally hosted service, like Maven Central for Java or the NPM registry for JavaScript.
